lesson.subtitle: Lesson 22 -- What Did You Do? -- A Busy Week in HR
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Dienane Brandão de Mesquita | Lesson 22 -- What Did You Do?
lesson.grammar_point: past simple regular verbs (-ed) in affirmative sentences

listenings.text: Hi, Dienane, it is Carla. I want to tell you about my week in the office. On Monday, I organized all the files for the new employees. On Tuesday, I printed the new contracts. On Wednesday, I answered more than fifty emails! On Thursday, I visited the store in Altamira with Marcos. And yesterday, I finished the report for the manager. Now I am very tired, but happy. Talk to you later!

Good morning, team. This is Marcos. Yesterday was a very good day. In the morning, we interviewed three candidates for the sales department. The manager liked two of them, and in the afternoon we hired a new salesperson. Her name is Julia, and she starts next week. I received her documents at five o'clock. Thank you all for your help. See you at the meeting!

extra_audio.text: On Monday, Dienane interviewed four candidates. On Tuesday, the manager hired two of them. On Wednesday, she organized the training room. On Thursday, she printed the new contracts. On Friday, she finished the week and received a thank you email.

reading.rtitle: HR News -- Last Week in Human Resources
paras: Last week was very busy in the HR department. Here is what we did.
Monday. We interviewed six candidates for the finance department. Dienane asked the questions, and Marcos checked the documents.
Tuesday. The finance manager called us. He liked two candidates, and we hired them on the same day.
Wednesday. Dienane organized the training room for the new employees. We printed thirty new contracts.
Thursday. We received forty emails about the new health plan, and we answered all of them.
Friday. We finished the monthly report at four o'clock. Then we celebrated with coffee and cake!
